title.zh: Bitcoin Falls as Hot Inflation Puts a Fed Hike Back on the Table
title.en: Bitcoin Falls as Hot Inflation Puts a Fed Hike Back on the Table

current_state.zh: Hotter-than-expected September U.S. inflation (3.7% YoY) roughly doubled the odds of an October Fed rate hike and pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to ~5.3%, sending Bitcoin down 1.5% to $82,142 alongside broad crypto weakness (ETH -2.8%, SOL -1.9%, XRP -1.3%).
